experiment: P3o-T deployable MFT-support conditional ISRJ residual
question: Can an observable MFT inverse-delay support descriptor, gated only by the frozen predicted MFT posterior, reduce MFT-to-ISRJ false positives without removing MFT evidence or degrading safety, ranking, and predicted-gate parameter utility?
evidence_boundary: fresh-identity formal development only; no confirmation, test, or locked test is generated or opened in this stage

conditions.T0_base: Frozen MLCNN logits and frozen P2c safe thresholds; no residual.
conditions.T1_zero_side_residual: Equal-capacity ISRJ-only residual over detached frozen MLCNN global feature and predicted MFT posterior; support input is zero.
conditions.T2_support_conditional_residual: The same residual receives a fixed complex-LFM inverse-delay support summary from raw compound I/Q.
conditions.T3_matched_noninformative_control: The same residual receives a deterministic fixed-phase-scrambled support summary with matched dimensions and per-sample norm.

residual_training.checkpoint_rule: minimum selection corrected-ISRJ BCE, deterministic first-epoch tie break
residual_training.conditional_loss: mean softplus(corrected_ISRJ_logit - frozen_base_ISRJ_logit + 0.0) over MFT=1 and ISRJ=0 samples only
residual_training.mft_gate: detached sigmoid(frozen MFT logit); no label, oracle component, or parameter target is used at inference

calibration.secondary_selection_only_threshold: ISRJ threshold selected on selection role by maximum recall subject to every regime-power observed FPR <= 0.08 and one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson upper bound <= 0.15; all non-ISRJ thresholds remain frozen

stop_rule: Any failed development gate freezes this hypothesis, its identities, and its reserved confirmation roles. No loss, support, threshold, checkpoint, seed, or capacity retuning is allowed on these identities.
